Slow VLM reasoning (S2) + fast reactive visuomotor policy (S1).
Dynamics/appearance mismatch between simulator and hardware.
Run model inference while executing the previous action chunk to hide latency.

Map human MoCap/video motion onto a robot's kinematics for tracking.
Preserve VLM semantic priors from being washed out by action fine-tuning.
